'''Camp Conquest''', formerly known as '''Outpost Victory''', was a [[Balmorran resistance]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] before the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] bombed the site and constructed a new military base within the crater left by the bombing.
